notes: A156869_conjecture: for n >= 1, integer m with n+m >= 1, T(2n+m, n+m) = A156870 n <-> 0 <= m, T = Set.ncard of nondecreasing positive lists with reciprocal sum k. Route: prepend 1 is injective S(N,K) -> S(N+1,K+1), onto when N <= 2K (no-1 lists have sum <= length/2); all-twos list of length 2K is missed from S(2K-1,K-1); finiteness via least entry <= length/sum. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (agreement with data rows 1..6 by certificate/brute.py).
